{{Quote|We know now why those Gungans raiders were so eager to catch Captain Vanool. One of the Gungans he landed on was their leader. Since they're raiders, we'd like you to destroy their hideout. Thanks to Captain Vanool's happy accident, we know exactly where it is. Think you're up to it?|Vana Sage|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Yuzza Vanool''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Captain Vanool accidentally landed a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] on a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] leader, prompting the Gungans followers to enact retribution. [[Vana Sage]] later tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with rescuing Captain Vanool from the vengeful Gungans.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yuzza Vanool was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
